findings.summary: The allowlist now authorises by six verified properties rather than by file name, and detects stale entries. It ends stricter than it began, which is what TASK-011 required.
Scope discipline held. ASES-0002 declared the callers as prohibited paths, so the session reviewing them could not edit them to make them pass.

The checks are textual rather than semantic; an unusual formatting of a hostile call could evade them. Twelve synthetic probes confirm they are not vacuous, which bounds the concern without removing it.
git is still resolved through PATH and inherits GIT_ environment variables. Pre-existing baseline shared with diff.mjs; not introduced by B3 and not closed.
